'''2008 Worlds Team Michael Richards LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Richards]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Bearded Clam Eaters. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Richards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
